What an unsophisticated but real planning team does: size the rotable float to cover the quoted shop turnaround at the quoted removal rate, and run static min/max on count parts. It is mediocre (no safety stock, trusts vendor quotes, ignores transport and queues) rather than absurd.

assumptions.value: "network float = ceil(quoted annual removals x quoted shop TAT / 365): no transport, no queueing, no allowance for quoted-MTBUR optimism or variability, no safety stock. All at AUH, except 1 unit (taken from the float) at an outstation when the PN is D0 and quoted annual removals at that station >= 4"

limitations.title: The data is synthetic
limitations.detail: The airline, fleet, part numbers, removals, repair orders and AOG events are generated

limitations.title: Simulated rates are not reliability data
limitations.detail: MTBUR, condemnation rates and repair TATs are drawn from configured ranges

limitations.title: The models are tested on a world the author designed
limitations.detail: The generator draws removals from exposure ÷ MTBUR, which is exactly the structure the reliability-exposure forecast assumes

limitations.title: Vendor-quoted MTBUR noise is assumed
limitations.detail: The quoted figure is truth × lognormal noise (σ_log 0.35) and 25% optimistic on average

limitations.title: Demand is unconstrained and uncensored
limitations.detail: Every requirement is recorded whether or not stock existed

limitations.title: Two years of history
limitations.detail: Parts with very few removals cannot be forecast from their own history; they rely on the quoted MTBUR.

limitations.title: No exposure feedback from groundings
limitations.detail: A grounded aircraft keeps accruing its scheduled flying (protection by spare aircraft or sub-charter is assumed)

limitations.title: Deadline classes are hypothetical, not MEL
limitations.detail: D0, D3 and D10 are simple requirement windows (0, 72, 240 h)

limitations.title: No cannibalisation (robbery) modelled
limitations.detail: A real operator facing an AOG may remove a serviceable part from another aircraft in heavy maintenance

limitations.title: Simplified repair shop
limitations.detail: Two shops with fixed parallel slots, first-come first-served queues, no priority for AOG cores, no beyond-economic-repair quote cycle, no warranty claims, no partial repairs or part-out, and no shop-capacity shocks

limitations.title: Close to single-echelon
limitations.detail: Repairs happen only through the hub

limitations.title: Transport times are fixed planning values
limitations.detail: AOG transport hours per station pair are ASSUMED constants

limitations.title: Simplified scheduled maintenance
limitations.detail: Only A-checks at AUH generate kits, with fixed notice

limitations.title: Parts are independent
limitations.detail: No interchangeability, no alternate part numbers, no next-higher-assembly logic, no kits containing rotables, no common-cause failures across parts.

limitations.title: Single currency, static prices
limitations.detail: All AED, no exchange-rate movement, no price escalation, no minimum order quantities or price breaks.

limitations.title: The AOG penalty is a scenario
limitations.detail: AED 15,000/h (narrowbody) and 30,000/h (widebody) are planning values

limitations.title: Carrying cost is a single rate
limitations.detail: 20% per year (range 15–25%) covers capital cost, storage, insurance and obsolescence together

limitations.title: The optimiser is a greedy heuristic
limitations.detail: Marginal analysis is optimal only for separable, convex objectives, and then only at the budgets where greedy steps land

limitations.title: The optimiser works on an analytic proxy
limitations.detail: The frontier is built from deadline-weighted EBO, then each candidate is checked in the event engine

limitations.title: Pool exchange (P3) is not implemented
limitations.detail: The engine has no pool mechanics (the hook raises `NotImplementedError`); the AOG Response Lab shows a pool option only as a greyed, indicative estimate with ASSUMED terms

limitations.title: Paired seeds narrow intervals within this world only
limitations.detail: Confidence intervals reflect simulation noise across 20 seeds, not uncertainty in the assumed parameters

limitations.title: One fleet, one network
limitations.detail: Results are for a 40-aircraft, seven-station network

limitations.title: Not an approved maintenance, airworthiness or dispatch tool
limitations.detail: It does not replace an approved MEL, an MRO/ERP system, an AOG desk, or certification paperwork (such as an authorised release certificate).

limitations.title: Independent project
limitations.detail: Not affiliated with any airline, OEM, vendor or MRO organisation, and uses none of their data or systems.
